renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Yogini-born or Rudra — neither plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, which frees through yoga at once. Speak it right, and the great mantra-seal host stands face to face now, marked by the body's own thrill.

Remember it a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed — and he binds all, body and seal-host. Asked, he tells past and future, voicing the meant god-form within three hours. He sees the sure thing face to face, drawn by Rudra's powers; skywalking in two watches, remembering.
By three: all mothers, strong yoginis, heroes, perfected, the sakini crew. They come, pledge got, sent by Bhairava — supreme success, whatever fruit is wished.

By this the perfected perfect, and mantra-men are made; whatever works in Bhairava's Tantra works through this — by mantra-might's indwelling, with no boss. Who truly knows even the unseen circle always shares success — a yogin and an initiate too.
